queue.title: Selective terminal rescoring of one-step shortlist
queue.hypothesis: Terminal planning contains decision-boundary information that can improve first-action terminal recovery when applied only to a top-3 one-step shortlist at bounded compute.

checkpoint.next_action: Run seed 60001 atomically under frozen top-3/four-rollout design, persist complete world result, then continue sequentially.

established_findings: Unconditional two-step search does not improve the primary metric after RNG isolation and costs roughly 9x compute.
Historical width-2 breadth showed benefit in an unrecoverable implementation lineage, but that effect cannot be assumed to transfer to benchmark v2.
Simple adaptive breadth thresholds and local-margin depth gates failed prior preregistered validation.
Nonlinear-aware likelihoods improve absolute nonlinear recovery but do not establish a breadth advantage.
A simple model-disagreement proposal bonus worsens recovery prospectively.
A single unmodeled latent common cause can reverse the historical breadth advantage.
Historical EXP-002 runs are not exactly resumable because executable mechanics and per-world seed/state lineage were not persisted.

Fresh benchmark v2 has a frozen executable engine, exact 29,281-DAG support, budget 15, strict nested breadth, posterior-predictive EIG scoring, isolated RNG namespaces, and a source-addressed manifest.

Benchmark-v2 n=48 replication does not support unconditional width-2 superiority: width2-width1 edge error +0.014, 95% CI [-0.242,+0.275], identical 60.4% MAP recovery, about 2.06x planner simulations.
The breadth null is not explained by simple proposal redundancy.
EXP-002R5 supports Monte-Carlo EIG winner's-curse as a diagnostic mechanism, but EXP-002R6 falsified compute-matched variance-reduced EIG racing as the direct fix.
Local one-step EIG alignment with terminal recovery is heterogeneous; simple posterior-state gating, edge-centric utility replacement, and action-space orthogonalization were falsified prospectively.
EXP-002R11 found posterior-predictive discrepancy but falsified it as the dominant decision-failure mechanism.

EXP-002R12 falsified exhaustive full remaining-budget terminal VOI as a general ranking mechanism: mean rank-alignment change -0.044 (95% bootstrap CI [-0.426,+0.372]) and mean compute 37.7x one-step. Its argmax nevertheless reduced terminal edge-error regret in 4/6 worlds and mean regret from 0.312 to 0.122, motivating selective decision-boundary rescoring rather than exhaustive deep planning.
dynamic_enqueue_rules: Every completed experiment must generate at least one next candidate unless a stronger queued candidate already tests the same uncertainty.
Falsification never empties the queue; it narrows or redirects it.
Do not enqueue equivalent retries without a changed causal hypothesis, state representation, reward, search depth, world model, or evaluation design.
Promote surprising anomalies and control victories into diagnostic experiments.
Maintain matched resource budgets and preserve all negative results.
